exam_facts_provenance.note: Physical p12 (printed 12, PRELIMINARY EXAMINATIONS) lists the tests given when applying for a license or instruction permit: '1. A vision test', '2. A knowledge test relating to rules of the road and traffic control devices', '3. A practical road test', and says the knowledge and road tests may be waived for class 1 through 3 applicants holding a provisional or out-of-state license. Full-text searches across all 132 extracted pages for pass/percent/questions/correct/score/passing grade found no question count, passing score or percent, or time limit for the class 3 knowledge test (the only percentages are crash statistics and the trailer-load figure); nulls are genuine absences, never imported from memory. Note: this PDF's text layer also carries a superseded hidden layer on many pages (e.g. p12 hidden lines '1. Rules of the Road / 2. Vision / 3. Recognition of traffic control devices' and 'You must pass these tests before you are permitted to take the driver performance road test'), which is not visible when the page is rendered; the verbatim quoted here is the visible text.
exam_facts_provenance.recorded_from: handbook page text (intake spec); issuer page statements in receipts/issuer-current-edition-confirmation.json
